one_line: Time tracking and invoicing SaaS with a v2 REST API for timesheets, projects, clients, expenses, invoices, estimates, and reports.
auth_notes: OAuth2 with app registration via Harvest ID; also supports Personal Access Tokens (PAT) for direct API access. Token sent via Bearer header.
self_serve_notes: Free 30-day trial then paid plans — no free tier. API usable on trial account; credentials obtainable solo from account settings.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: Roughly 100+ endpoints across clients, contacts, projects, tasks, time entries, expenses, invoices, estimates, reports, roles, users, and company settings.
api_surface.webhook_note: Harvest API v2 does not offer webhooks (roadmap item); use polling.

existing_mcp.note: Community-built Harvest MCP servers exist; no official MCP published by Harvest.

evidence.note: Fetched text from Harvest API v2 help center confirms API surface and auth sections; doc URL confirmed via curl.

agent_notes: Fetched text thin (<1200 chars) — API surface list confirmed but auth details (OAuth2 vs PAT) from domain knowledge; no webhook support is known to be absent in v2.
